jobs.prompt: Remake the exact BRINE Core corner console in image 1 in the accepted hand-painted industrial art style of image 2. Image 1 controls function, module arrangement and L silhouette; image 2 controls matte material and painterly construction only. life-support: long horizontal teal coolant reservoir, two filter cartridges, paired service cylinders and several inset diagnostic screens. Preserve recognisable functional modules but simplify excessive tiny buttons and heavy bevels, group controls into fewer readable dark-teal flat futuristic screens. Pearl-white ceramic/powder-coated metal housings, charcoal seals, subdued brushed steel pipes and muted teal fluid/glass accents. No bright reflection streaks, white glow, chrome, bloom or thick cartoon outlines. Quiet precise aquatic AI machinery. Elevated overhead cutaway camera with useful visible tops and shallow inward-facing cabinet fascia. Outer horizontal north back and outer vertical left edge MUST be straight and flush-fitting for square rooms. L top run across top and return down left, open inner corner. Preserve approximately original overall proportions and narrow run widths, no diagonal isometric skew, no huge protruding screens or pipes. Make front lips and inner side plane readable with restrained contact shading. This is a supported fitted console, not flat circuitry painted on floor, and not a tall wall. Match detail density at about 376px overall export width. Full isolated asset with margins, TRUE TRANSPARENT exterior and inner void, remove source white background. No floor, actual walls, labels, people, cast shadow or room. Keep turquoise accents subdued and unlit.
